claim: Changing servings scales and combines matching ingredient amounts.
where: workspace, How it works, README, and catalog
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; assert the seeded 1.2 kg tomato total, change the first Cook for value from 6 to 8, then assert 1.45 kg and both scaled recipe sources

claim: Converted and incompatible units stay visible for review.
where: How it works, shopping list, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; enter matching ingredients in kg and g, then assert the review marker and both scaled source amounts

claim: Unit conversions use fixed published measures.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; combine one cup and one tablespoon and assert the exact converted cup total

claim: Pantry checks remove items from the shopping list and survive reload.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; check tomatoes, reload, and assert pantry grouping

claim: Exports recipes and cart choices as JSON.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; save a pantry choice and a total override, download JSON, and assert recipes plus both cart-choice fields

claim: Imports recipes and cart choices from Batch Cart JSON.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; upload a valid fixture with a recipe, pantry key, and total override; assert the restored pantry row and edited total

claim: Shares the calculated shopping list.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo with share API spy; assert calculated ingredient text

claim: Opens a printable shopping list.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo with print spy

claim: Demo changes never enter real cart data.
sandbox: fresh browser context; edit /demo, start real, and assert an empty real cart

claim: Demo data is deleted when you leave the demo.
sandbox: fresh browser context; edit /demo, exit through Privacy, Cart, wordmark, Back, a hard non-demo load, and Start for real; each time assert demo IndexedDB is absent and reopening demo restores the shipped sample

claim: The demo opens three recipes with a ready shopping list, and Reset demo restores them.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; assert all three named recipes and the ready list, change one recipe, reset, and assert the original sample

claim: Shopping-list totals can be edited and saved.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; edit a calculated quantity, unit, and name, reload, export, and assert the saved override

claim: Recipe data stays in the browser.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; edit a recipe while recording requests and assert no other origin is contacted

claim: Uses no analytics, trackers, third-party runtime scripts, or CDN fonts.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /; record every initial request and assert each uses the app origin

claim: A stored license is verified at most once per day.
sandbox: fresh browser context with a stored license; load twice within one frozen day and assert one verification request

claim: License verification sends only your license token to api.sociobot.in.
sandbox: fresh browser context; paste a test token, intercept the verification request, and assert its URL contains only that token with no request body

claim: A license that is no longer active removes Plus features while the free cart stays available.
sandbox: fresh browser context with a cached valid verdict and demo edit; return a revoked fixture, then assert Plus is removed and free cart data and controls remain

claim: Stores a returned Plus license in this browser.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1&license=test-token; intercept verification and assert the returned token is stored after the address is cleaned

claim: Batch Cart does not scrape recipe sites.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; enter a recipe URL as ingredient text, assert a local validation error, and assert no other origin is contacted

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; load once, set context offline, reload, and assert sample data

claim: Plus saves named event plans and restores them later.
sandbox: fresh browser context with a cached valid verdict; save a sample plan, edit, restore, and assert original data

claim: The active cart, serving controls, pantry checks, print, share, import, and export have no time limit without a license.
where: landing facts, Plus section, terms, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo without a license and with time set ten years ahead; change servings, move a pantry item, print, share, export, and import a fixture, asserting each observable result after the future clock change

claim: Delete local data removes the real cart, sample cart, saved plans, and license from this browser.
sandbox: fresh browser context with both IndexedDB namespaces and license keys; use Delete local data, confirm, and assert both databases and all license keys are absent

claim: Batch Cart Plus is US$12 once and uses the Sociobot hosted checkout.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /; assert exact price copy, Sociobot checkout URL, HTTP 303, and Dodo hosted-checkout destination
